day3_night_start.name: Me
day3_night_start.text: *Home at last. Friday night. Weekend starts tomorrow.*

day3_night_reflect.name: Me
day3_night_reflect.text: *I lie on my bed and think back over the day.*

day3_night_reflect_trouble.name: Me
day3_night_reflect_trouble.text: *The whole thing came out at lunch. The icy air, the sharp stares -- still fresh in my mind. Can I survive this weekend in one piece?*

day3_night_reflect_tension.name: Me
day3_night_reflect_tension.text: *My plans have piled up on top of each other. Each time a face flashes through my mind, my heart races and I break into a cold sweat. I need to manage my time carefully.*

day3_night_reflect_normal.name: Me
day3_night_reflect_normal.text: *I'm looking forward to tomorrow. What kind of day will it be?*

day3_night_phone_check.name: Me
day3_night_phone_check.text: *I check my phone. There are messages waiting.*

day3_night_msg_seoyeon.name: Seoyeon
day3_night_msg_seoyeon.text: *22:03* '{name}, still up? I'm really looking forward to tomorrow.'

day3_night_seoyeon_suspicious.name: Seoyeon
day3_night_seoyeon_suspicious.text: *Follow-up message* 'But... I'm the only one you're seeing, right? No other plans?'

day3_night_seoyeon_lie.name: Seoyeon
day3_night_seoyeon_lie.text: '...Good. I'll trust you. See you tomorrow.'

day3_night_seoyeon_angry.name: Seoyeon
day3_night_seoyeon_angry.text: '...Fine. This weekend will tell me everything I need to know.'

day3_night_seoyeon_jealous.name: Seoyeon
day3_night_seoyeon_jealous.text: *Follow-up message* 'What happened at lunch today... it's still bothering me. Just be honest with me.'
choices: 'Sorry, I couldn't say no to anyone...'
'You're the most important one to me.'

day3_night_seoyeon_apologize.name: Seoyeon
day3_night_seoyeon_apologize.text: '...I appreciate the honesty. But I have no intention of sharing you. You're mine. Right?'

day3_night_seoyeon_reassure.name: Seoyeon
day3_night_seoyeon_reassure.text: '...Really? Don't you ever forget those words. If you smile at someone else over me tomorrow... I can't be held responsible.'

day3_night_seoyeon_normal.name: Seoyeon
day3_night_seoyeon_normal.text: 'Figured out where we're going tomorrow? You can leave it to me. Good night.'
choices: 'I'll leave it to you. Good night.'

day3_night_yuna_witnessed.name: Yuna
day3_night_yuna_witnessed.text: *Follow-up message* 'After school today... I saw you leaving with Seoyeon.'

day3_night_yuna_reassure.name: Yuna
day3_night_yuna_reassure.text: '...Really? I'll believe you. But if you betray me...'

day3_night_yuna_threat.name: Yuna
day3_night_yuna_threat.text: '...Don't think about running. Wherever you go, whoever you're with -- I'll know.'

day3_night_yuna_knows.name: Yuna
day3_night_yuna_knows.text: *Follow-up message* '...You made promises to the others too, didn't you?'

day3_night_yuna_knows_2.name: Yuna
day3_night_yuna_knows_2.text: 'It's fine. Struggle all you want -- you're still in the palm of my hand. Look forward to tomorrow night.'

day3_night_msg_dain.name: Dain
day3_night_msg_dain.text: *21:00* 'HEY!! Tomorrow 9 AM at the gym!! Don't you DARE be late!!!'

day3_night_dain_suspicious.name: Dain
day3_night_dain_suspicious.text: *Follow-up message* 'But... did you really make plans with other people too? I heard at lunch.'
choices: 'The time slots are different, so it's fine.'

day3_night_dain_priority.name: Dain
day3_night_dain_priority.text: 'Really?! Then we're good!! I'll show you something amazing tomorrow!!'

day3_night_dain_honest.name: Dain
day3_night_dain_honest.text: '...Yeah? Hmph! I don't care! I'll be a hundred times more fun than any of them!! You'll see tomorrow!!'

day3_night_dain_excuse.name: Dain
day3_night_dain_excuse.text: 'Hmm... if the timing works out, I guess it's fine. But you better give me your full attention!'

day3_night_dain_normal.name: Dain
day3_night_dain_normal.text: *Follow-up message* 'After practice let's go get tteokbokki!! My treat!!'

day3_night_nurse_2.name: Nurse
day3_night_nurse_2.text: 'You haven't forgotten about Sunday evening, have you? I'll have something special ready.'

day3_night_nurse_excited.name: Nurse
day3_night_nurse_excited.text: 'Get excited. Sleep tight and I'll see you Sunday, {name}.'

day3_night_nurse_curious.name: Nurse
day3_night_nurse_curious.text: 'It's a secret~ You'll find out on Sunday.'

day3_night_msg_teacher.name: Teacher
day3_night_msg_teacher.text: *22:00* '{name}, you haven't forgotten our museum plans on Sunday, have you?'

day3_night_teacher_2.name: Teacher
day3_night_teacher_2.text: 'It's been a while since I've had an outing, so I'm looking forward to it. Sunday, 2 PM, museum entrance.'

day3_night_no_message.name: Me
day3_night_no_message.text: *No special messages. What should I do this weekend?*

day3_night_ignore_all.name: Me
day3_night_ignore_all.text: *I decided to sleep without checking my messages. I can look at them in the morning.*

day3_night_sleep.name: Me
day3_night_sleep.text: *Just as my eyes are about to close... my phone rings. A call.*

day3_night_phone_seoyeon.name: Seoyeon
day3_night_phone_seoyeon.text: *I pick up and hear Seoyeon's voice* "...{name}? I know it's late. I just wanted to hear your voice."

day3_night_phone_seoyeon_freetalk.name: Me
day3_night_phone_seoyeon_freetalk.text: *A late-night call with Seoyeon. Her voice in the dark room sounds softer than usual.*
day3_night_phone_seoyeon_freetalk.context: Late-night phone call. Seoyeon called saying 'I just wanted to hear your voice.' A sweet late-night conversation.
day3_night_phone_seoyeon_freetalk.personality: Seoyeon is the cool-beauty type. Sharp-tongued, composed, with a sly charm. She's possessive and bluntly direct when jealous.

day3_night_phone_yuna.name: Yuna
day3_night_phone_yuna.text: *I pick up and hear Yuna's voice* "...I know it's late. But I couldn't sleep."

day3_night_phone_yuna_freetalk.name: Me
day3_night_phone_yuna_freetalk.text: *A late-night call with Yuna. The faint sound of her breathing reaches my ear.*
day3_night_phone_yuna_freetalk.context: Late-night phone call. Yuna called saying 'I couldn't sleep.' A quiet, intimate atmosphere.
day3_night_phone_yuna_freetalk.personality: Yuna is languid, blunt, and marches to her own beat. She speaks in short, cryptic sentences. Cold on the surface, but there's a gap when she opens up.

day3_night_phone_dain.name: Dain
day3_night_phone_dain.text: *I pick up and hear Dain's voice* "...Hey, I know it's late. But I keep thinking about tomorrow and I can't sleep!"

day3_night_phone_dain_freetalk.name: Me
day3_night_phone_dain_freetalk.text: *A late-night call with Dain. Instead of her usual energy, she speaks in a quiet voice. It's a different side of her.*
day3_night_phone_dain_freetalk.context: Late-night phone call. Dain called saying 'I keep thinking about tomorrow and I can't sleep.' A quieter-than-usual Dain.
day3_night_phone_dain_freetalk.personality: Dain is a puppy-energy type who loves physical contact and is fiercely competitive. Exclamation mark machine. Tsundere. Upbeat on the outside, sensitive on the inside.

day3_night_phone_nurse.name: Nurse
day3_night_phone_nurse.text: *I pick up and hear her voice* "...{name}? Still up? I couldn't sleep either."

day3_night_phone_nurse_freetalk.name: Me
day3_night_phone_nurse_freetalk.text: *A late-night call with the Nurse. Her low, soft voice brushes against my ear.*
day3_night_phone_nurse_freetalk.context: Late-night phone call. The Nurse called saying 'I couldn't sleep either.' Her low, soft voice.
day3_night_phone_nurse_freetalk.personality: The Nurse is playful, alluring, and mature. She's torn between her feelings for the student and her ethics as a teacher.

day3_night_phone_teacher.name: Teacher
day3_night_phone_teacher.text: *I pick up and hear her voice* "...{name}? Still up? I know I should be sleeping, but..."

day3_night_phone_teacher_freetalk.name: Me
day3_night_phone_teacher_freetalk.text: *A late-night call with Teacher. Her quiet voice sounds closer than usual.*
day3_night_phone_teacher_freetalk.context: Late-night phone call. Teacher called saying 'I know I should be sleeping, but...' Her quiet voice.
day3_night_phone_teacher_freetalk.personality: Teacher has a dry sense of humor. Seems blunt on the surface, but there's a gap when she catches herself having feelings for a student.

day3_night_phone_end.name: Me
day3_night_phone_end.text: *I hang up and set the phone down. The echo of that voice lingers in my chest.*

day3_night_sleep_2.name: Me
day3_night_sleep_2.text: *My eyes drift shut. Tomorrow is Saturday... what kind of day will it be?*

day3_night_sleep_final.name: Me
day3_night_sleep_final.text: *All those promises swirl around in my head. Can I really keep everyone happy...*

day3_night_nightmare.name: Me
day3_night_nightmare.text: *...I'm dreaming. Voices echo from a dark void.*

day3_night_nightmare_voice1.text: *Seoyeon's voice* "...You said you'd only see me, remember? You pinky swore..."

day3_night_nightmare_voice2.text: *Yuna's voice whispers coldly* "...I told you, betray me and you'd regret it. Remember?"

day3_night_nightmare_voice3.text: *Dain's voice trembles* "...You said you'd come! You promised you wouldn't bail...!"

day3_night_nightmare_choice.name: Me
day3_night_nightmare_choice.text: *Hands reach out from the darkness. Whose hand will I take?*

day3_night_nightmare_end.name: Me
day3_night_nightmare_end.text: *I reached out... but there was nothing to hold. They all vanished, and all that remained was darkness and regret.*

day3_night_nightmare_wake.name: Me
day3_night_nightmare_wake.text: *...I'm drenched in sweat. My heart feels like it's about to burst. It was a dream. But... what's going to happen tomorrow?*

day3_night_peaceful.name: Me
day3_night_peaceful.text: *A peaceful night. I'm looking forward to tomorrow.*

day3_night_loyalty_seoyeon.name: Me
day3_night_loyalty_seoyeon.text: *...Thinking about Seoyeon makes me smile without even trying. Tomorrow is just us. Time to show her how I really feel.*

day3_night_loyalty_yuna.name: Me
day3_night_loyalty_yuna.text: *...Thinking of Yuna makes my heart race. Tomorrow night, the place she wants to show me. Will I get to see the real her?*

day3_night_loyalty_dain.name: Me
day3_night_loyalty_dain.text: *...Picturing Dain's smile makes me smile too. Tomorrow's practice match -- she's going to be so happy I came.*

day3_night_loyalty_nurse.name: Me
day3_night_loyalty_nurse.text: *...The Nurse's face comes to mind. I know this is wrong... but I can't hide what I feel.*

day3_night_loyalty_teacher.name: Me
day3_night_loyalty_teacher.text: *...I picture Teacher's smile. We may be teacher and student, but what I feel is real.*
